provenance.movement_reasoning: Workdays repeatedly return Mara's entry essentials and office bag to the entry/dining area and Theo's pocket items to the entry, with his bottle and lunchbox accumulating by the sink and jacket on a chair. Meals move dishes through table, sink, rack, and cupboards; tea leaves Mara's mug on the drying area. Evening screen, reading, yoga, bathing, laundry, and cleaning create the smaller living-room, bedroom, bathroom, and utility movements. Tidy-up reliably restores the main habitual homes, while infrequent travel and deep-clean use are represented with NO_OP mass.
provenance.persona_reasoning: A compact, practical inventory for a young couple whose fixed daytime jobs create coordinated departures and shared evening use of the kitchen and living room.
